node.title: KoalaBear m2 r2 residual coefficient-quartic pin
node.closure: symmetric sibling correspondence, exact quadratic pullback substitution, and irreducible degree-four equality
node.statement: For either surviving full-V4 dihedral profile, normalize the endpoint quadratic as h(t)=t^2 and write k(sigma,pi)=0 for the symmetric bidegree-(2,2) sibling correspondence between the two Y values above one Z value. In unordered source-root coordinates S=t+s and P=ts, the residual birational coefficient image is exactly the canonical plane quartic k(S^2-2P,P^2)=0. This pins the realization equation but does not construct or delete n=3 or n=6.
